rv.q: It's an extraordinary play about very ordinary people involved in every parent's worst nightmare.
This visually rich, wonderfully paced, aurally thrilling production keeps us wide-eyed and on tenterhooks for more than two hours.
Frozen is one of the best plays in recent memory to seem so transitory.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Play

aw.sub: Won Best Featured Actor in a Play

vs.sum: Broadway's only thrust-stage theater offers an unmatched intimate experience — no seat is more than a few rows from the action. Sightlines are excellent from every angle, though some seats face actors' backs during certain scenes.

acc.note: Elevator accessible through adjoining building. Loop technology and neck induction systems available.
